description.value: Basecamp Burger Joint is a casual sit-down burger and breakfast restaurant perched on Esplanade Avenue in Harrison Hot Springs, a well-known cycling destination in the Fraser Valley. The kitchen builds burgers from 100% Premium Alberta beef patties made in-house, and the menu ranges from classic egg benedicts and buttermilk pancakes through to a grilled wild salmon burger and a fully vegan Beyond Burger. Its lakeside village location makes it a natural mid-ride or end-of-day refuelling stop for cyclists coming off the Harrison or Vedder corridor routes.
